"""Search the web repeatedly and yield each result batch.

Generator: calls ``search(query)`` on every iteration and yields the returned
result batch. It never stops on its own, so the caller must stop iterating.
"""

def search_loop(search, query):
    while True:
        yield search(query)

"""Search the web repeatedly and yield each result batch.

Generator: calls ``search(query)`` on every iteration and yields the returned
result batch. It never stops on its own, so the caller must stop iterating.
"""

def search_loop(search, query):
    while True:
        yield search(query)
```
